# Synthetic captured-source handoff

`synthetic-source.zip` was generated by the actual proposed Mindcap producer
at `7ee766c1c34adad239fc602499f624979a2d9cac` (Mindcap draft #42). It contains only
the authored records in `records.json`, immutable synthetic raw JSON, two separate
normalized members and `CAPTURED-SOURCE.json`. One URL is an inert bookmarklet.
No original private archive, browser profile, credential or machine path appears.

The owner schema is vendored byte-for-byte in
`contracts/v1/captured-source-bundle.schema.json`, SHA-256
`bdc8d83a75ee8e6510ff97aecb943451a42e13a59f764cc6109d36ea558840a6`.
This is draft compatibility against an exact owner pin, not accepted upstream
adoption, complete incremental capture or support for arbitrary Mindcap archives.

The optional `experiments/capture_handoff/check.py` additionally runs the actual
Mindcap bookmark capture plugin against its committed synthetic profiles, exports
two independent observations and verifies equal normalized content through the
same adapter. Its temporary originals remain private. The ordinary engine tests
and CLI do not import Mindcap or require its dependencies.
